Protocol: If TSH > 10 uIU/mL on two separate instances of lab values (separated by at least one month in date of lab collection), start levothyroxine 25 mcg PO daily and order repeat TSH/FT4 in 6 weeks. If TSH is 4.5–10 uIU/mL and free T4 is normal (0.8–1.8 ng/dL), order repeat TSH/FT4 in 3 months (no medication yet).
